rules.statement: An acknowledgment of a debt made after the limitation period has run is valid and effective to start time running again.
rules.supporting_quote: In view of my finding that the Prescription Ordinance merely bars the remedy with lapse of time and does not extinguish the debt, there is no rational justification to insist that an acknowledgment must be made before the expiry of the limitation period to be effective. I hold that an acknowledgment of the debt to be effective for the purposes of section 12 of the Prescription Ordinance need not be made before the expiry of the period of limitation.
